vocab.definition: loss of electrons (or gain of oxygen).
gain of electrons (or loss of oxygen).
a reaction where oxidation and reduction both happen.
Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain (of electrons).

misconceptions.right: Oxidation is loss of electrons — oxygen need not be present.
Reduction is gain of electrons / loss of oxygen.

misconceptions.wrong: Only one species changes in redox.
misconceptions.right: One is oxidised AND another is reduced.

infoPanels.title: REDOX EXAMPLE
workedSteps: Use OIL RIG to decide which is which.

questions.text: Define oxidation and reduction in terms of electrons. [2 marks]

questions.secondaryText: Oxidation is the ______ of electrons; ______ is the gain of electrons.

questions.text: Explain why a displacement reaction is a redox reaction. [2 marks]
